person_note: The authorized opening presents a nonparticipating third-person narrator with access to Carla's thoughts and then changes focal character to Lloyd without changing grammatical person. Multiple Goodreads passages independently show the same pattern around Daisy, Lloyd, Greg, Carla, and other characters. Apparent first-person examples are dialogue, thought, song, or other local voices, not sustained base sections. The whole-book structural description confirms an omniscient third-person narrator coordinating nine viewpoints. No credible evidence establishes a sustained first- or second-person base section; the only material uncertainty is that the authorized primary excerpt covers the opening rather than the entire novel. Quote audit: q01805 and q01817 are locally unmarked; their pronouns and character references do not independently establish THIRD.
